patterns.note: The page primarily uses a single-column layout for extensive informational text, transitioning to a two-column grid for download options and a multi-column footer for navigation links.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold display headings for key announcements and a highly readable sans-serif for body text, ensuring legibility across content types.
A high-contrast color scheme features dark text on a light, off-white background, with a vibrant orange used strategically for calls to action and to highlight important phrases.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining access to key links without any visual transformation.

A large, detailed, full-width illustration of astronauts in a futuristic setting serves as a distinctive visual anchor at the bottom of the page, providing an imaginative counterpoint to the informational content.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, without any visual transformation. Content is presented in a linear scroll, with no visible scroll-triggered animations for elements appearing or transforming. The large illustration at the bottom is a static image that becomes visible as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold display headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, functional navigation/footer text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable line spacing and paragraph breaks, with airy sections around the hero and illustration).

standout: The site stands out by transparently communicating its 'winding down' status with a clear, helpful tone, rather than trying to hide it. This is visually reinforced by a clean, direct design, unexpectedly capped by a large, detailed, futuristic illustration that hints at the product's original vision, creating a unique blend of practicality and imaginative flair.
